name: Annihilan Strike generates 2 Felfury on hit (#4665)
contract: Annihilan Strike 801903 promises two Felfury on a landed two-weapon attack. The active DBC classifies the
parent and both weapon children as melee damage; melee hit and expertise ratings guarantee a successful
hostile hit. Spell hit rating alone leaves dodge, parry and melee misses uncontrolled. No Twin Fury talent
is learned, so critical strikes do not add talent resource grants. The native cast must generate two Felfury.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: no Felfury before the cast
DISCRIMINATING: both weapon hits landing grants the DBC's 2 Felfury
